exposure: assessment of transgender status based on self-identified gender and sex assigned at birth
responses to gender identity questions at screening, enrollment, and follow-up
outcome: consistency of gender identity responses over time
cohort: The study included 401 participants, originally targeted as men who have sex with men (MSM), recruited in Kenya, Malawi, and South Africa.
finding: Categorizing persons as transgender based on self-identified gender and sex assigned at birth has limited reliability in African populations.
